 What exactly is an proxy-email ? +

 Proxy-email or email alias is similar to forward email address: all emails sent to proxy-email will be forwarded to your inbox. 

 You can generate unlimited amount of emails at @proxiedmail.com (like helloworld@proxiedmail.com) and all sent emails to the proxy address will be forwarded to your real email like a john@gmai.com. 

 Additionally, you can turn off forwarding from this proxy-email or change the pair of proxy-email -> real email address.
